CustomField.description: This field calculates how long the visitor was in the waiting area in minutes.
CustomField.formula:
/* Date Time fields are resulting in full days. So multiple by 24 hour and 60 minutes per hour to get the minutes */
(Called_To_Service_Desk_Date_And_Time__c - CreatedDate) * 24 * 60
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How many minutes was the visitor in the waiting area.
CustomField.label: Registered Duration (Minutes)
